[LSTO.4.3.4.3] The runtime does not enforce or verify persistence.
The declaration is informational — it enables the runtime to surface
the right metrics (`cache_type="write_through"` label) and to trigger
startup hydration when configured. A write-through hook that drops or
reorders writes is a silent durability bug in the integration: the
engine's own cache stays correct in-session, but cross-restart
recovery is only as good as the hook.
